Code

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) < 2 {
		fmt.Println("usage: izrss <feed>")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	for i, arg := range os.Args[1:] {
		fmt.Printf("%d: %s\n", i, arg)
	}
}
